subject: Forté mattress selection: put the comparison into practice
preheader: A practical next step when static, hybrid or powered support surfaces need to be assessed at home.
trialFooterText: Sleep Choice covers the seven-night in-home trial at no cost to the participant.
intro: Comparing static, hybrid and powered mattresses is useful. The harder question is how the preferred option performs for a particular person in their own home.
Sleep Choice can help occupational therapists turn the clinical discussion into a structured seven-night home trial across the Forté range.
sectionTitle: Assess the mattress where it will be used
body: A home trial gives the participant and clinical team time to assess comfort, positioning, transfers, usability and overnight experience before a recommendation is finalised.
We can help identify a sensible starting configuration, coordinate the trial and respond if the first setup does not provide enough confidence.
If you have a client whose bed or mattress decision needs closer examination, reply to David or Alex and talk us through the clinical problem.
date: Tell us what is not working
time: We will help narrow the options
detail: Clinical discussion first. Equipment recommendation second.
